headline: Clashes Mount Across Northern Fronts As Sector Turnover Intensifies
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline friction has broadened considerably across the northern war theatre, led by severe engagements in Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse. Callahan's Passage remains the bloodiest focal point, recording over 2,100 combined casualties and five base exchanges across the past two hours around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. Weathered Expanse has reignited with three recent base changes and heavy bilateral losses, contesting Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance. Along the western approaches, Nevish Line continues its fierce see-saw combat with three base turnovers in the last watch, while Palantine Berm has seen casualty rates accelerate once again alongside fresh clashes at The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni. In Stlican Shelf, active skirmishing yielded two base transfers between Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost amid steady casualty pressure. Conversely, the high attrition in Mooring County has begun to cool following earlier fighting at The Wind Hills, while the southern territorial expanses remain entirely dormant.
